blockers.quote: The metro platform, twenty to seven in the morning, nearly empty.
blockers.why: Check #2 Confirm the click fails: the first seven seconds show a stranger on a platform, not the thumbnail’s academy-street hug and minus-eighty-four card.
blockers.fix: Replace the platform opening with the line 43 academy-street scene. Start on Min-jun reaching for the hug, sound the paper snap immediately, and land -84% by 0:07.

blockers.quote: So what if every piece of good news showed you who wants you to fail?
blockers.why: Check #3 Second hook by 0:30 fails: the title question arrives after the platform setup, and the viewer still does not know the top-four goal or the cost of getting caught.
blockers.fix: Move this question directly after the -84% reveal, then add by 0:30: “You need one of four places. The card could show who is racing you. Get caught reading it, and the whole class turns on you.”

blockers.quote: The camera pulls up and back until the street is a field of cream cards with three red ones.
blockers.why: Check #20 Escalating set pieces fails: the thousand-face spectacle comes before the later hundred-person class and five-hundred-person hall, so the power’s scale contracts after its midpoint image.
blockers.fix: Resequence the uses as class, hall, then thousand-card street before midpoint; stage Backs and the window payoff academy-wide so the final use exceeds the street in scale as well as cleverness.

suggestions.quote: Anyone who goes red: out of the group chat. No past papers. No notes.
suggestions.fix: Show your best friend’s name being removed first; that makes the under-question drive the weapon montage instead of sitting beside it.

suggestions.quote: Minus never meant they want you to fail. It meant it hurt.
suggestions.fix: Use “Minus never proved they wanted you to fail. It only proved your win hurt.” This preserves the rival/friend ambiguity instead of replacing one absolute with another.

keep.quote: Zero. Grey. One click. The biggest news of your life, and you're a receipt.
He isn't sawing your chair. He's building a ladder. Out of your mistakes. You've been his textbook for two years.
A face in a mirror is still a face. The toilets weren't broken. The one card you can't see was always yours.
